# Applitools

> Applitools is an AI-powered end-to-end testing platform that combines proprietary Visual AI with generative AI and no-code approaches to maximize test coverage, automate maintenance, and reduce false positives. The platform has been trained over a decade on more than 4 billion application screens to deliver human-like judgment at automated speed and scale.

Applitools serves development, QA, and digital leadership teams across regulated industries including financial services, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, retail, and technology. Its AI does not hallucinate — it is deterministic and purpose-built for software testing.

## Products

### Applitools Eyes
- [Eyes Overview](https://applitools.com/platform/eyes/): Visual AI testing tool that automatically detects visual and functional regressions across web, mobile, desktop, and PDF applications. Replicates human vision to catch UI/UX bugs with every release.
- [Ultrafast Grid](https://applitools.com/platform/ultrafast-grid/): Renders and validates tests in parallel across browsers, devices, and viewports — dramatically reducing cross-browser test execution time.
- [Execution Cloud](https://applitools.com/platform/execution-cloud/): Intelligent cloud infrastructure for running tests at scale.

### Applitools Autonomous
- [Autonomous Overview](https://applitools.com/platform/autonomous/): AI-augmented platform for creating, executing, and analyzing functional, visual, and API tests. Supports NLP authoring and autonomous test creation.

### Other Products
- [TestGenAI for Cypress](https://applitools.com/platform/testgenai/): AI-powered test generation for Cypress test suites.
- [Codeless Recorder](https://applitools.com/platform/create/codeless-recorder/): No-code test creation tool for any team.
- [NLP Builder](https://applitools.com/platform/create/nlp-builder/): Author tests using natural language.

## Platform Capabilities

### Create
- [SDKs](https://applitools.com/platform/create/sdks/): Integrates with 50+ frameworks including Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, and TestCafe across multiple languages.
- [Codeless Recorder](https://applitools.com/platform/create/codeless-recorder/)
- [NLP Builder](https://applitools.com/platform/create/nlp-builder/)

### Validate
- [Visual AI](https://applitools.com/platform/validate/visual-ai/): AI-powered computer vision that compares baseline screenshots and identifies meaningful regressions while ignoring noise (dynamic content, rendering differences, date/time fields).
- [Cross Browser Testing](https://applitools.com/platform/validate/cross-browser-testing/): Test across all major browsers, OS configurations, and viewports.
- [Accessibility Testing](https://applitools.com/platform/validate/accessibility/): Automated accessibility validation integrated into the testing workflow.
- [Release Strategies](https://applitools.com/platform/validate/release-strategies/)

### Execute
- [Test Orchestration](https://applitools.com/platform/execute/test-orchestration/): Coordinate and scale test runs across infrastructure.
- [Self-Healing Tests](https://applitools.com/platform/execute/self-healing-tests/): Tests automatically adapt to UI changes, reducing maintenance burden.

### Analyze
- [Root Cause Analysis](https://applitools.com/analyze/root-cause-analysis/): Pinpoints the exact DOM elements responsible for visual defects.
- [Automated Maintenance](https://applitools.com/analyze/automated-maintenance/): Groups similar test differences for one-click batch resolution.
- [Test Insights](https://applitools.com/analyze/test-insights/): Dashboards and analytics to track test health, coverage, and trends.

## Integrations
- [All Integrations](https://applitools.com/platform/integrations/): 60+ integrations including Cypress, Selenium, Playwright, Appium, Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub, CircleCI, Jira, and more.

## Deployment Options
- **SaaS**: Hosted on Applitools cloud — up and running in minutes.
- **Private Cloud**: Run on Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform in a dedicated environment.
- **On-Premises**: Deploy behind your own firewall for maximum security and regulatory compliance.

## Security & Compliance
- ISO 27001 certified
- SOC 2 Type II compliant
- Current penetration testing reports
- SSO and SAML support
- GDPR and CCPA compliant
